title: What Is Self-Evaluation? — Easiest Explanation
skills: define self-evaluation and explain its purpose
assess strengths, weaknesses, and areas for improvement
use evidence to reflect on performance and progress
set realistic goals based on self-assessment
alignment_note: Introduces self-evaluation as a reflective process for assessing performance, identifying strengths and areas for growth, and setting purposeful goals. Supports metacognition, reflective writing, revision, academic growth, and student ownership of learning across high school English courses.
